data.animaCaption: Kneeling amid the crisp white sheets with her silver hair in loose twin braids and her mint polka-dot nightgown slipping off one shoulder, she leans slightly forward with a shy morning blush. Soft dawn light through sheer curtains brightens her eyes and collarbone.
data.promptProse: Shot in a gently tilted horizontal close-up across a sunlit summer bed, Ayachi Nene kneels on rumpled white sheets wearing her canonical mint-green polka-dot short-sleeve nightgown, her silver hair plaited into soft twin braids resting over her chest. As she leans slightly forward with both palms pressed into the mattress, the wide neckline slips loosely off one shoulder to show her collarbone and gentle cleavage while her face warms with an earnest morning blush. Diffused early sunlight passes through sheer window curtains, casting delicate bright highlights over the bedding and her braids.
data.story: 清晨阳光透过薄纱帘照亮了整张床铺。编着双麻花辫、穿着薄荷圆点家居裙的宁宁跪坐在被单边轻轻探身靠近，刚醒的嗓音软糯又带着一丝试探——「醒了吗？今天的早晨……好像比平时安静得多呢。」
